snippet.title: Lord of Undead - Demo - Trailer
snippet.description:
Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.
Play on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4018330/
